name: Still Water
description: An album for meditation, breathwork and rest: a paced breathing guide, singing bowls, chant, sea, rain and forest, a body scan that moves around your head, and gentle binaural drones for sleep. Slow tempos, long envelopes and nothing sudden.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Breath Guide
sketches.description: Paced breathing at six breaths a minute. Breathe in for four seconds while the chord swells, and out for six while it fades. A soft bowl marks each new breath.
sketches.source:
setcpm(6)

// One cycle is one breath of ten seconds: in for four, out for six
// Breathe in as the chord swells, breathe out as it fades
breath: note("<[d3,a3,f#4] [b2,f#3,d4] [g2,d3,b3] [a2,e3,c#4]>")
  .struct("x@2 ~@3")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .attack(4).sustain(1).release(6)
  .lpf(900).room(.7).size(.9).gain(.2)

// A soft bowl at the start of every breath
bowl: note("d4").s("sine").fm(1.5).fmh(2.76)
  .decay(6).sustain(0).release(6).space("hall").gain(.18)

// A low drone and the sea far away
drone: note("[d2,a2]").slow(4).s("sine").attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).gain(.16)
surf: s("surf").intensity(.3).distance(4).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Singing Bowls
sketches.description: A sound bath: FM singing bowls struck slowly, ringing long and drifting across the stereo field above a low hum.

sketches.name: Ocean Breath
sketches.description: Waves on a quiet shore with a warm pad that rises and falls like the tide. Let your breathing follow the water.
sketches.source:
setcpm(50/4)

// The shore
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.45).gain(.32)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.06)

// A warm pad that swells and recedes like the tide
pad: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,c4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.25)
  .attack(3).release(4)
  .lpf(sine.range(400, 1200).slow(8)).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.16)

// A few clear notes, like light on the water
shimmer: n("<4 ~ ~ 2 ~ ~ 6 ~>").scale("F:major").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).decay(2).sustain(0).release(2)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.4).room(.7).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Temple Dawn
sketches.description: A choir breathes open fifths over a reed drone. Distant bells sound, and the morning birds sing outside the temple walls.

sketches.name: So Hum
sketches.description: A mantra meditation: a single voice sings 'so' on the in-breath and 'hum' on the out-breath, over a ringing drone. Repeat it silently with each breath.
sketches.source:
setcpm(48/4)

// So on the in-breath, hum on the out-breath: one breath every two cycles
mantra: note("g3 d3").slow(2)
  .s("voice").syl("so hu").voicetype("alto")
  .mono(1).vglide(.2).attack(.6).release(2)
  .space("hall").gain(.34)

// A ringing drone on the tonic and fifth
drone: note("d2 a2 d3 a2").slow(2).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright")
  .unison(2).detune(.08).attack(.02).decay(2).sustain(.4).release(3)
  .lpf(1400).room(.6).gain(.18)

// The hum underneath
hum: note("d2").slow(8).s("hum").overtone(5).gain(.16)

sketches.name: Forest Clearing
sketches.description: Headphones on: you sit in a clearing by a stream, with birds placed around you, insects in the grass and a slow wooden flute.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// The stream and the breeze
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(-30).distance(2).gain(.26)
breeze: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.08)

// Birds around the clearing, one wandering slowly overhead
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(60).distance(4).gain(.3)
thrush: s("bird").slow(5).azimuth(saw.range(-150, 150).slow(16)).elevation(30).distance(6).posglide(.4).gain(.24)
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(120).distance(3).gain(.1)

// A slow wooden flute
flute: note("<[g4@3 a4] b4 [d5@3 b4] a4 [g4@3 e4] d4 ~ ~>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.3).sustain(.6).release(1.2)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.26)

sketches.name: Rain Retreat
sketches.description: Rain on the roof of a quiet retreat. Sparse piano notes fall into the reverb, and a seeded random choice leaves the same few out each time.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)

// Steady rain on the roof
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.45).gain(.3)

// Sparse piano notes, a few gently left out
piano: n("<[0 ~ 4 ~] [~ 2 ~ ~] [5 ~ ~ 4] [~ ~ 2 ~]>").scale("F:major").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.25).seed("retreat")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(1.5).sustain(.1).release(2)
  .room(.7).size(.9).gain(.3)

// Soft low chords holding everything together
chords: note("<[f2,c3,a3] [d2,a2,f3] [bb1,f2,d3] [c2,g2,e3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(1).sustain(.5).release(3)
  .lpf(900).room(.6).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Body Scan
sketches.description: Headphones on: a soft humming tone circles your head and slowly rises. Follow it with your attention, from your feet to the crown of your head.

sketches.name: Delta Sleep
sketches.description: Headphones on: a gentle 2 Hz binaural beat in the delta range, over warm brown noise and a pad that barely moves. For falling asleep.

sketches.name: Theta Drift
sketches.description: Headphones on: a 6 Hz binaural beat in the theta range for deep meditation, under slow choir chords and a stream. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
